title: Black Cat
summary: Black Cat / Portable Trusted Linux has completed M13B on the tested real-hardware configuration. The corrected no-typing System Check reached BLACK CAT - QUICK CHECK after non-fatal ACPI AE_NOT_FOUND firmware messages; the prior /run/blackcat report Permission denied regression was absent. A read-only lsblk observation then showed the 14.6G sda live USB mounted at /run/live/medium while the 476.9G internal nvme0n1 and all four of its partitions had no mount points. This closes the M13B physical gate as OBSERVED evidence on the tested hardware, not as a universal or attested guarantee. M14 — authenticated release signing — is now current. The exact candidate identity is preserved below as development evidence; there is still no approved release. AI autonomy, compact recovery and the future fail-closed M26 project-automation scaffold remain repository-governed.

candidate.note: TEST CANDIDATE — NOT AN APPROVED RELEASE. This corrected M13B image passed its automated smoke gates and its physical no-typing retest on the tested hardware. The old report Permission denied errors were absent, and the internal 476.9G NVMe plus all partitions showed no mount points while the 14.6G live USB was mounted at /run/live/medium. The result remains OBSERVED evidence, not a signed/approved release or universal assurance.

release.note: No Black Cat ISO is currently an approved release. M14 now focuses on authenticated release signing. Development candidate identity and physical observations do not themselves constitute release authenticity.

sections.title: Automation Manifesto — proceed by default
sections.content: Black Cat engineering proceeds automatically through safe, reversible, auditable, already-authorized work. Human interruption is reserved for physical hardware interaction, destructive or difficult-to-reverse actions, platform/trust-ownership changes, new credentials or authorization, secret exposure risk, financial/legal/public-release commitments, material security-policy choices, or essential information that genuinely cannot be derived safely.

sections.title: AI autonomy policy — when GPT continues automatically
sections.content: AI_AUTONOMY_POLICY.md at the repository root is the canonical operational decision table. Routine safe engineering proceeds automatically; high-impact trust, release, credential, destructive and public-service boundaries remain human gates.

sections.title: Recoverable AI chat continuity and context health
sections.content: AI_WORK_STATE.md is the compact first-read recovery checkpoint. Context pressure uses heuristic GREEN/AMBER/RED signals, not a fabricated exact context percentage.

sections.title: Future native AI project automation in Black Cat Linux
sections.content: After M25, M26 plans a native user-space project facility backed by fail-closed machine-readable policy, a sandboxed capability broker and model-neutral workers. Runtime enforcement remains future work.

sections.title: Zero-new-inbound automation policy
sections.content: The earlier inbound controller proposal remains superseded. Existing GitHub Actions are the default automation infrastructure.

sections.title: Black Cat visual identity and boot branding

sections.title: Current focus
sections.content: M14 — authenticated release signing — is now the active engineering milestone. Community Compute Commons remains paused.

sections.title: Core trust chain
sections.content: Authenticated release reference -> verified USB image -> UEFI/Secure Boot -> measured boot and TCG event log -> TPM PCR evidence -> signed UKI -> authenticated dm-verity root -> immutable Linux -> RAM-backed disposable state -> nonce-bound TPM Quote -> independent verifier -> attestation report.

sections.title: Current Test Candidate versus Approved ISO
sections.content: The M13B candidate remains preserved as exact development evidence, but there is still no Approved Black Cat ISO. M14 exists specifically to add authenticated release signing before release promotion can mean more than identity/provenance.

sections.title: Canonical fail-closed project viewer
sections.content: The cPanel-hosted viewer remains protected-token only and fail-closed, temporarily reading the authoritative development branch while PR #6 is unmerged.

sections.title: Operational status versus project authority
sections.content: Local builder/server telemetry is display-only and cannot alter candidate or release authority.

sections.title: M13B physical result
sections.content: M13B passed on the tested hardware/configuration. The corrected candidate reached BLACK CAT - QUICK CHECK without the old Permission denied report-write errors. A read-only lsblk listing showed sda 14.6G as the live USB with sda1 mounted at /run/live/medium and loop0 as the live squashfs. The internal nvme0n1 476.9G plus nvme0n1p1, p2, p3 and p4 had no mount points. This establishes OBSERVED default-unmounted internal-disk behavior on this tested boot only.

sections.title: Evidence classification
sections.content: The M13B result is OBSERVED physical evidence. Secure Boot ENABLED is a firmware-state observation, not proof of an authenticated Black Cat chain; later signing, UKI, dm-verity and attestation milestones provide stronger classes of evidence.

sections.title: M14 signing boundary
sections.content: Prototype 1 models build/release signing separately from Secure Boot signing. Private keys must never be committed to GitHub. The next automatic work is to design and test the release-signature/verification flow without creating or exposing a production signing key. Key ownership/custody remains a human trust-policy gate.

sections.title: Current candidate provenance
sections.content: The completed M13B physical-test ISO is live-image-amd64.hybrid.iso, exactly 376438784 bytes, SHA-256 cb14d25b7fd43e2b0e563efaada357d6ab196a42d717b016c4857f85968fe641, from source commit c56389b71ecd96270bdd047369378f5a94d8bf93, workflow run 34686464650 and artifact 10300658965.

sections.title: Progressive hardening
sections.content: Temporary prototype controls remain explicitly weaker than the final trust model. Signing-key custody must not be weakened merely to simplify CI.

sections.title: Mandatory lessons discipline
sections.content: Every meaningful session updates the lessons register and affected technical documents; AI_WORK_STATE.md tracks compact handoff state and project_content.json is written last.

decisions.title: Reuse mature security components
decisions.text: Use Debian, UEFI Secure Boot, systemd UKI, TPM 2.0 and dm-verity rather than inventing replacement primitives.

decisions.title: Independent verification is mandatory
decisions.text: The target computer cannot be the sole authority deciding that its own measurements are trustworthy.

decisions.title: GitHub is the canonical development workspace
decisions.text: Documents, source and the living JSON index are versioned in the private repository.

decisions.title: Lessons learned are mandatory output
decisions.text: Every meaningful engineering/research session records lessons before project_content.json is updated last.

decisions.title: Prototype 1 baseline is Debian 13/trixie amd64
decisions.text: Exact build-host and package versions are captured as provenance.

decisions.title: Community Compute Commons paused
decisions.text: Active implementation focuses on the core trust chain.

decisions.title: Progressive hardening is mandatory
decisions.text: Temporary weaker controls must be explicit and replaced by stronger controls later.

decisions.title: Self-hosted GitHub Actions runner is the initial remote execution path
decisions.text: Repository-scoped Actions jobs provide the auditable path into the disposable build VM.

decisions.title: Build host and attestation target are separate roles
decisions.text: The cloud VM builds artifacts; UEFI/TPM claims require a separate capable target.

decisions.title: Black Cat is the user-facing brand
decisions.text: PTL remains the stable internal engineering shorthand.

decisions.title: No-typing hardware diagnostics
decisions.text: Provide a dedicated Black Cat System Check boot path.

decisions.title: Physical boot is an observation, not attestation
decisions.text: A successful USB boot proves bootability only on the tested configuration.

decisions.title: Approved releases are separate from CI candidates
decisions.text: Development artifacts must not be confused with authenticated approved releases.

decisions.title: Systemd is the sole Black Cat quick-check evidence producer
decisions.text: The systemd service produces evidence once; the login hook is display-only.

decisions.title: Automation Manifesto pre-pause check is mandatory
decisions.text: Safe reversible work proceeds automatically until a genuine human gate.

decisions.title: Automation convenience must not create new inbound attack surface by default
decisions.text: Existing GitHub Actions remain the default; new public services require separate justification.

decisions.title: Root AI autonomy policy is the operational continue/stop authority
decisions.text: AI_AUTONOMY_POLICY.md classifies AUTO, AUTO_WITH_CHECKS, HUMAN_GATE and FORBIDDEN_BY_DEFAULT actions.

decisions.title: Compact repository state makes AI chat dropouts recoverable
decisions.text: AI_WORK_STATE.md is the first-read recovery checkpoint.

decisions.title: Reusable AI project policy defaults fail closed
decisions.text: The future M26 seed grants no root/raw-device/credential/network/listener authority by default.

decisions.title: M13B passes physical no-typing and internal-disk-default-unmounted gates
decisions.text: On the tested hardware, the corrected candidate reached BLACK CAT - QUICK CHECK without the old report Permission denied errors. Read-only lsblk evidence showed the live USB mounted while the 476.9G internal NVMe and all partitions had no mount points. This remains an OBSERVED result limited to the tested configuration.

decisions.title: M14 becomes the active milestone
decisions.text: Authenticated release signing is now the current engineering focus. Release-signing identity remains distinct from later Secure Boot signing identity, and production private-key ownership/custody is a human trust-policy gate.
